entities.summary: Rei Kawakubo is a Japanese fashion designer based in Tokyo and Paris. She is the founder of Comme des Garçons and Dover Street Market. In recognition of the notable design contributions of Kawakubo, an exhibition of her designs entitled Rei Kawakubo/Comme des Garçons, Art of the In-Between opened on 5 May 2017 at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in Manhattan, modeled by Rihanna. Rei Kawakubo was a performers & entertainers from Tokyo (b. 1942-10-11, Tokyo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
